To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) the spatio-tempora activity of upscaled videos can be measured with high accuracy using SITImean and 2) this measure can be used to predict the perceived quality of upscaled video.

the SITImean measure is a good predictor of the perceived quality of upscaled video, which can be used to optimize the video upscaling process and to reduce the number of subjective quality evaluation tests.

the newly-introduce SITImean measure is highly correlated with the subjective quality scores, and that the spatio-temporally activity of the upscaled video is the main factor that influences the perceived quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the objective quality measure, which could be used in real-time video streaming services.
the development of the spatio-temporally activity measure for the evaluation of upscaled video.
the development of the objective quality assessment method for upscaled video.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SITImean is a good predictor of upscaled video subjective quality, especially for the case when the video is presented on smartphone.
SITImean is the best measure for upscaled video quality prediction.
the temporal activity of the upscaled video is a better predictor of its quality than the spatial activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the spatio-temporally activity of upscaled videos has an influence on its perceived quality and the SITImean is a good predictor of this quality.
the spatio-temporally activity of the upscaled video is an important factor for its perceived quality.
the SITImean measure is a good indicator of upscaled sequence activity and can be used to estimate its perceived quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activity measure should be calculated in a spatio-temporal manner, not only spatial or temporal.
the temporal upscaled video activity is the most important factor influencing the perceived video quality.
the SITImean measure can be used to predict the perceived video quality, while the spatial and temporal activity measures are not sufficient for that.
